title: HELIX Bridge: Salesforce → Gift
architecture_notes: Only closed-won donation opportunities become gifts. Pledges and their payments map separately so CASE totals don't double count. Allocations to general accounting units become the designation. Anonymous and tribute fields must carry through to stewardship rules.

source_objects.description: NPSP payments against a gift or pledge.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + Opportunity.Id (or GiftTransaction.Id).

attribute_mappings.source: Opportunity record type and Type; pledge vs payment
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map through helix/gift-type (outright_gift, pledge, pledge_payment, matching_gift, planned_gift, in_kind, stock_transfer, and so on).
Fund or designation name; split gifts produce one designation per allocation.

Boolean. Suppress name in any published list when true.

extraction_methods.description: Default. SOQL by SystemModstamp high-water mark; queryAll to include deleted rows. Included with API-enabled editions.
Near real-time change events for objects that need freshness. A limited number of objects is included; more needs an add-on. Check your contract.
AWS-managed Salesforce to S3 flows, scheduled or event-triggered. Priced per flow run and data processed on the AWS side.
Only if the institution already licenses Salesforce Data 360. Not required for HELIX.

validate: Object and field names follow Salesforce's published Agentforce Education (formerly Education Cloud), EDA, NPSP, and standard object models, but orgs add custom fields and record types. VALIDATE every field against your org's describe output before building extracts; custom fields end in __c.
